tokendanceRechargeBackendNotReady: This backend is not ready for safe payment orders. Ask the administrator to update it; no order has been created.
tokendancePaymentFinalCheck: The order reached its deadline. Checking payment one final time…
tokendancePaymentUnconfirmed: The order has expired, but payment could not be confirmed. If you have paid, verify it on the official TokenDance website. Do not recharge again blindly.
tokendanceRechargeNotice: Confirm to create an order, then pay explicitly. Top-ups do not reset the API key's periodic quota. Payment is recognized only after confirmation by the server.
tokendanceRechargeFailed: The operation could not complete. Please retry.
tokendanceRechargeInvalid: Enter an integer from 1 to 100000 CNY.
tokendanceRechargeDesktop: Use a desktop browser to scan the payment QR code.
tokendanceRechargeQrUnavailable: This payment QR code could not be generated. You can recharge manually on the official TokenDance website instead. Avoid paying both orders.
tokendanceRechargeSuccess: Payment of {{amount}} has been confirmed. You can close this window and continue using TokenDance. Do not pay again.
tokendanceRechargeBalanceDelayed: Your top-up succeeded, but the balance could not be refreshed yet. Check your balance later; there is no need to pay again.
tokendancePayment_expired: Order expired; close this dialog and create a new order.
tokendanceRecoveryTopUp: Your TokenDance balance is insufficient. Top up the account used for this connection, then retry. The current key remains valid.
tokendanceRecoveryReauthorize: This TokenDance key is no longer usable. Reauthorize the platform connection, then retry.
tokendanceRecoveryQuota: This key has reached its periodic quota. Wait for the quota to reset, or reauthorize the connection. No automatic retry or payment will be made.
tokendanceRecoveryAdminRequired: Contact your administrator to manage this platform connection.
